PRE-TREATMENT INSTRUCTIONS

  • Avoid retinol, exfoliants, and active skincare products for 3-5 days before treatment.
  • Refrain from sun exposure and tanning for 1 week prior.
  • Avoid Botox, fillers, or laser treatments 2 weeks before dermaplaning.
  • Arrive with clean skin (no makeup, lotion, or sunscreen).

POST-TREATMENT INSTRUCTIONS

  • Expect mild redness or sensitivity for a few hours post-treatment.
  • Keep skin hydrated with a gentle moisturizer.
  • Avoid active skincare (retinoids, acids, exfoliants) for 3-5 days.
  • Wear SPF 30+ daily and avoid prolonged sun exposure.
  • No harsh scrubs, waxing, or aggressive treatments for 1 week.
